name: B10-0182/2024 (PPE) – Georgia's worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 parliamentary elections were badly flawed and should not be recognised. It wants them run again under international supervision, and an independent international investigation into fraud and voter intimidation. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Georgian officials, including Bidzina Ivanishvili, and to review Georgia's visa-free travel. It also wants the European Union to give frozen money to Georgian civil society and independent media instead of the government.

- The EU is asked to consider sanctions and to review Georgia's visa-free travel.
- Georgian officials, Bidzina Ivanishvili and Georgian citizens who travel to the EU are affected.
- The EU and Georgia's government must now respond; the parliament's demands are not yet law.
